payload.reason: The evidence provides specific comparisons of the proposed models against baseline models, including LSTM and transformer architectures, across various datasets.

claims.text: The models with ReWE consistently outperformed the LSTM and transformer baselines across different datasets.
In the eu-en dataset, ReWE+ReSE improved results by $+5.15$ BLEU pp over the corresponding baselines.
In low-resource settings, regularizers like ReWE and ReSE show larger margins of improvement over baselines.
In high-resource settings, the performance of ReWE and ReSE may not be beneficial compared to the baseline.
